cv.name: Priya Kulkarni
cv.headline: Process Engineer – Pulp, Paper & Specialty Chemicals
cv.summary: Chemical engineer with six years in process engineering for pulp and paper and specialty chemicals plants in Georgia. Focused on yield improvement, process safety and supporting operations on the floor.

experience.title: Process Engineer II
bullets: Process engineer for a resin plant running three continuous reactor lines
Led a distillation column optimization that raised solvent recovery by 6%
Facilitate HAZOP and MOC reviews for process changes
Support operators on troubleshooting and write updated SOPs

experience.title: Process Engineer
bullets: Supported the bleach plant and recovery boiler areas
Built Aspen Plus models to evaluate chemical usage

experience.title: Co-op Engineer
bullets: Collected process data and supported a pump reliability study

skills: Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, AVEVA PI
P&ID review, mass and energy balances
